P.name: The Darkin Scythe
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayn''' has a secondary {{tt|experience bar|Additional info in the notes below}} that tracks progress toward his {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}} forms. He gathers orbs from champion {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} and each instance of damage (excluding {{tip|damage over time}}) dealt against champions. Once he has earned enough orbs, he unlocks a form based on whether he earned more from {{tip|melee}} or {{tip|ranged}} champions (for {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}}, respectively), with the other form unlocked later.
P.description2:
While near his team's [[Spawn|summoning platform]], '''Kayn''' {{tt|can choose a form|By clicking on the portrait in the HUD}} to enter transformation over 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. At the end of the transformation he is restored to full {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}}. The transformation will grant a passive bonus and permanently empower some of '''Kayn's''' abilities based on the form chosen. He gains a one-time [[Homeguard]] once the transformation is complete.

'''''Kayn''' cannot activate the transformation while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} Upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions, '''Kayn''' becomes empowered for 3 seconds to deal {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 40}} of {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage dealt against enemy champions as {{tip|magic damage|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}. This effect cannot trigger again until '''Kayn''' has been out of combat with champions for over 8 seconds, with the timer being reset if he recasts ''{{ai|Umbral Trespass|Kayn}}''.
P.description4: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} '''Rhaast''' {{tip|heals}} for 25% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} that he deals to enemy champions with his {{tip|abilities}}.

Q.name: Reaping Slash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to nearby enemies.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|75 to 195}} {{as|(+ 85% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|75*2 to 195*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|85*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Both instances of ''Reaping Slash'' deal {{as|40 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|75+40 to 195+40}} {{as|(+ 85% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|(75+40)*2 to (195+40)*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|85*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Reaping Slash's'' damage is modified to deal {{as|65% AD}} {{as|(+ 6% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each hit, for a total of {{as|{{ap|65*2}}% AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5*2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}. This damage has a cap against monsters that does not include the '''bonus''' damage.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Capped Monster Damage per Hit|{{ap|200 to 400}}|Total Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}}}}

W.name: Blade's Reach
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' swings his scythe in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description2: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach's'' radius is extended by 200 units. '''Kayn''' conjures an {{tip|untargetable}} ''shadow'' at the casting position to perform ''Blade's Reach's'' sweep over {{fd|0.55}} seconds in his stead, removing the ability's cast time.
W.description3: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach'' {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit for 1 second.

E.name: Shadow Step
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|ghosting}} and the ability to ignore terrain collision for a duration. If he has been [[combat status|in combat]] with enemy champions within the last 3 seconds, ''Shadow Step'' will instead last {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: '''Kayn''' {{tip|heals}} himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting ''Shadow Step'' and he gains {{tip|unobstructed vision}} while inside.
E.description3: Receiving damage from or dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} while ''Shadow Step'' is active reduces its remaining duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds. This effect also cannot remain active out of terrain for longer than {{fd|1.5}} seconds and will cancel immediately if '''Kayn''' performs a [[basic attack]] or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.
E.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Shadow Step's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 10 seconds at all ranks. '''Kayn''' gains 100% {{tip|slow resist}} while active and, upon entering terrain, the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} is increased to {{as|70%|ms}} for the remaining duration.

R.name: Umbral Trespass
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kayn''' ''marks'' enemy champions he damaged in the last {{fd|3.15}} seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a ''marked'' enemy champion over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|attach|attaching}} himself to them at the end of the dash. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his arrival, he {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds, during which the target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Umbral Trespass'' can be recast during the channel after {{fd|0.1}} seconds have elapsed, and does so automatically after the duration or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} After a delay of {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds to {{fd|0.75}} seconds|See notes}}, '''Kayn''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target and {{tip|dash|dashes}} out from their body in the target direction, detaching himself from them and becoming targetable again at the end of the dash.
R.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range and emerge range. Additionally, emerging will reset ''{{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Kayn|The Darkin Scythe's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' is modified to deal {{as|physical damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, and also {{tip|heals}} '''Rhaast''' for {{as|{{ap|15*0.75}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.75}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} after the recast's delay.
